required_property: Owner default short-action labels and explicit caption/label values render as plain text without double escaping or preserving unsafe HTML.
description: PLAN01:83,95 and PLAN02:97 require forced plain escaping while owner defaults come from cv_get_action_short_label. src/crud_views/lib/view/base.py:578-592,638-643 returns already rendered mark_safe text. The plans do not distinguish pre-escaped default output from raw override/owner strings.
fix_hint: Define the normalization boundary and test ampersands/apostrophes/entities plus safe markup for both default and explicit labels; do not blindly adopt a particular escaping recipe.

resolution_evidence.quote: <action>Per D-01/D-03/D-05/D-07/D-09/D-11/D-13/D-14, create the single navbar module, its Pydantic NavItem(key: str | None = None, child: str | None = None, label=None, icon=None), NavBar(viewset: str, items: list[NavItem], template: str | None = None), and cooperative CrudViewNavBarMixin.cv_navbar=None. Keep declarations configuration-only and all resolution/building helpers private. Use Pydantic features available at 2.2.1; accept lazy translated labels without preserving HTML safety. Add one view-instance SimpleLazyObject in get_context_data without evaluating it, with None for modal requests (X-CV-Modal: true). Add the context-taking cv_navbar tag and guarded layout-B wrapper. Wire one real owner detail GET, declaration, lazy context, access then existing state helper, registered reverse and escaped identity/link HTML. Reuse the existing icon renderer. Addresses review concern R1: normalize only the already-rendered result of cv_get_action_short_label with one stdlib html.unescape pass, then remove SafeData by coercing to an exact built-in str (str.__str__(str(value))). This preserves its rendered ampersands/apostrophes without carrying HTML trust into navbar data. For raw str(owner), explicit NavItem.label, and child plural labels, remove SafeData the same way but never entity-decode them: literal entity-looking input must remain literal. Keep any markup characters as text, without stripping tags or adding an HTML parser/sanitizer. Ordinary Django autoescape then escapes the normalized text exactly once in text and attribute contexts; do not force-escape the rendered default a second time. Test default template literals and interpolated values, explicit labels and owner captions with ampersands, apostrophes, literal entity sequences, safe markup and lazy translations; assert both serialized escaping and parsed visible text, with no created markup. The tag selects bar.template or theme-path tags/navbar.html and returns exactly empty output with absent/None/falsy data. Keep base.py, router, ancestor policy and context-button implementation untouched. Addresses review concerns R7/R9: own the real-request harness inside test_navbar.py using a test-local locmem template loader prepended to normal loaders and cv_extends_template selecting that base. Derive the local base from the unchanged app/crud_views.html layout and insert the tag with whitespace-neutral delimiters immediately before its existing header/card; keep an otherwise identical tag-free base for paired comparisons. Do not edit the shared test base. Import tests.test1.project.urls before taking registry snapshots, matching isolated_routes in test_ancestor_authorization.py; reuse that context manager or preserve its ordering exactly. Restore registry and check_module._VOCAB_CACHE snapshots, temporary URLconf module, URL caches and ContentType cache in finally; snapshot/restore any existing ViewSet._default_permissions values touched by tests. First tests prove this real path, not only builder return dictionaries. Addresses review concern R13: viewset and child remain string names throughout declaration; no ViewSet object, callable resolver or registration-time lookup is accepted. Prove a declaration can precede registration of its owner and child, then renders after they register. Pydantic handles field-type errors at construction. Addresses review concern R11: items=[] is valid and renders nothing; NavItem() is structurally representable but an attached item with neither a nonempty owner key nor a nonempty child name is a named startup error. This keeps destination-shape diagnostics in the same cooperative check pipeline as A-04. Empty supplied names/keys are invalid selections, not aliases for an omitted key.</action>

<action>Implement D-07/D-10/D-11/D-12 and all template-level UI criteria. Identity remains ordinary escaped text, never a second heading or inferred anchor; owner icon is decorative via existing renderer, including supported host/element icon placement and empty-string suppression. Items partial owns a translated navigation landmark Sections for %(object)s using the plain owner caption; it works independently of the identity leaf. Use a list of anchors in declaration order, Bootstrap nav/nav-pills/flex-wrap, naturally sized links, mw-100 and text-break utilities on caption/list items/labels as needed. Retain full labels at small widths and scope every added class to navbar output. Adopt UI-SPEC's aria-current="true" for the active section (refines A-05's page marker because Item pages still activate Orders). Active anchors remain focusable/clickable; other items have no current marker. Do not introduce dynamic-tab semantics, write actions or a navigation script. Existing Bootstrap text-break wrapping is the bounded initial CSS choice: it avoids a new global stylesheet/link changing nonparticipant HTML; live reflow in plan 08 must prove unbroken text wraps. If existing utilities cannot satisfy that evidence, use a navbar-scoped asset loaded only by opted-in rendering and extend split/no-output parity tests before acceptance. Test zero/one/many, hidden first/middle/matching items, missing icons, SafeString/ordinary markup-bearing captions and labels including accessible-name attribute escaping, configured label/icon overrides and unchanged header placement. Addresses review concerns R1/R15: consume the exact built-in-str data normalized by plan01; templates autoescape once and never apply force_escape to a pre-escaped short-action result. Assert parsed owner/anchor/aria-label text for ordinary ampersands/apostrophes, entity-looking raw overrides and SafeString markup, as well as absence of injected nodes. Add msgid Sections for %(object)s with German msgstr Abschnitte für %(object)s to the existing core django.po and compile the owned django.mo using the installed polib.pofile(...).save_as_mofile(...) under .nox/tests-3-12-django-5-2/bin/python, as existing locale plans do (msgfmt is absent). Preserve the interpolation key and existing entries; do not sweep unrelated catalogs. Under translation.override('de'), render the real items partial and assert its accessible name equals Abschnitte für plus the plain owner caption, including punctuation/markup-bearing captions; English remains correct. Compare against the literal German text so a missing catalog cannot pass via an English fallback.</action>

resolution_evidence.quote: <action>After the supported example Nox environment exists, create a transient navbar_browser_settings module under .pytest_cache that imports project.settings and replaces only DATABASES default NAME with an isolated temporary SQLite file; preserve auth, templates and static configuration. From examples/bootstrap5 run the .nox/examples-3-12-django-5-2/bin/python interpreter via ../../ path with PYTHONPATH=../../src:.:../../.pytest_cache, --settings=navbar_browser_settings: migrate, seed, then runserver 127.0.0.1:8765 --noreload. Do not mutate a developer/demo database. Write BROWSER-CHECK.js as the reusable body for the available Playwright browser_run_code tool (uses its page argument; no npm install). Assert and record on the real served example: login Alice, follow landing/Customer/Notes/Orders/Item links; repeat Charlie for hidden Addresses and correct three-link order; normal full bar has four ordered links. At 1280px and 320px and a real 200% zoom/reflow-equivalent CSS viewport, measure document.scrollWidth <= document.clientWidth + 1 and every link bounding box within its parent. Record exact viewport/zoom method rather than claiming deviceScaleFactor is zoom. Exercise normal copy plus a >=120-character caption with an unbroken >=80-character token and a long multiword label, changing text in the isolated fixture/DOM without changing navbar classes and recording stress setup. Confirm at least two item rows in narrow stress state, no clipped/ellipsized text, hidden links or horizontal strip. Tab/Shift+Tab reaches visible links in order, including active; Enter follows exact href, and caption/icons are not extra focus stops. Verify accessible landmark name/current marker, absent tab roles, visible focus and normal-text contrast against actual Bootstrap styles. Capture desktop layout and narrow focused wrapped state; write JSON with source revision, browser/runtime, assertions, URLs, dimensions and screenshots. Test browser-native full document navigation with no navbar fetch/spinner/retry machinery. If CSS utilities fail reflow, fix only navbar templates/styles through the owning plan and rerun its no-output/nonparticipant tests before continuing. Browser inability remains an unmet human-check item; HTML snapshots cannot close it. Addresses review concern R12: the orchestration that creates the temporary settings/database and starts runserver must own a try/finally cleanup across setup, browser success, assertion failure and interruption. Reserve the settings path only if absent (do not overwrite another run's file), allocate the SQLite database in a unique temporary directory, record exact created paths and the launched process/session PID, and fail on an occupied port rather than stopping an existing process. In finally, stop and await only this run's server, remove only its settings file/bytecode and temporary database directory, and retain JSON/screenshots and failure evidence. Record cleanup results in BROWSER.json. The browser JS routine is executed inside this outer lifecycle; merely adding a JS finally cannot clean up a separately launched server. Exercise a deliberate failing assertion once, then verify server exit, released owned port and deleted owned transient paths before the successful run.</action>
